commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery)"
test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state)" = device
set +e
PTH="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge 2>&1)"
CODE="$?"
set -e
echo "PM_PATH_EXIT_CODE=$CODE"
echo "PM_PATH_LINES=$(printf '%s\n' "$PTH" | grep -c '^package:' || true)"
if printf '%s\n' "$PTH" | grep -q '^package:'; then echo "PRODUCTION_PACKAGE_INSTALLED=true"; else echo "PRODUCTION_PACKAGE_INSTALLED=false"; fi
if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm list packages | grep -Fxq 'package:pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'; then echo "PROD_LISTED=true"; else echo "PROD_LISTED=false"; fi
if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm list packages | grep -Fxq 'package:pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab'; then echo "LAB_LISTED=true"; else echo "LAB_LISTED=false"; fi
echo "PHONE_PROBE_PASS=true"
commands.output:
PM_PATH_EXIT_CODE=1
PM_PATH_LINES=0
PRODUCTION_PACKAGE_INSTALLED=false
